title: Complete Greek Mythological & Heroic Genealogies (Apollodorus The Library Loeb/Frazer & Hesiod Theogony / Catalogue of Women)

nodes.name: Hesiodic Primordials: Chaos → Nyx/Erebus & Gaia → Pontus (Phorcys, Ceto, Gorgons, Nereus & 50 Nereids incl. Thetis)
nodes.role: Sea Deities, Gorgons & Ancestors of Achilles's Mother Thetis
nodes.notes: Pontus + Gaia -> Phorcys & Ceto (Graiae, Gorgons Stheno/Euryale/Medusa -> Pegasus & Chrysaor -> Geryon & Echidna!) and Nereus + Doris -> 50 Nereids (Amphitrite, Thetis [mother of Achilles!], Calypso, Galatea).

nodes.name: Complete 12 Titans: Oceanus/Tethys, Coeus/Phoebe (Leto/Asteria), Hyperion/Theia (Helios/Selene/Eos), Crius (Astraeus/Pallas/Perses → Hecate), Iapetus & Cronus/Rhea
nodes.notes: Hyperion + Theia -> Helios (father of Circe, Pasiphae & Aeetes of Colchis -> Medea!), Selene, Eos (mother of Memnon & Phaethon). Coeus + Phoebe -> Leto (mother of Apollo & Artemis) & Asteria (mother of Hecate). Pallas + Styx -> Nike, Cratos, Zelus, Bia.

nodes.name: Zeus & Mnemosyne → 9 Muses (Calliope → Orpheus & Linus), Horae, Moerae (Fates) & Charites (Graces)
nodes.role: Divine Patrons of Arts, Fate & Mythic Poets
nodes.notes: Calliope + Oeagrus (or Apollo) -> Orpheus (Argonaut & singer) & Linus; Zeus + Themis -> 3 Horae (Eirene, Eunomia, Dike) & 3 Fates (Clotho, Lachesis, Atropos); Zeus + Demeter -> Persephone; Zeus + Metis -> Athena.

nodes.name: Aethlius & Calyce → Endymion → Aetolus → Porthaon → Oeneus → Meleager, Deianira & Tydeus → Diomedes
nodes.role: Aetolian Royal House (Calydonian Boar Hunt & Hero Diomedes of Troy)
nodes.notes: Calyce (daughter of Aeolus) + Aethlius (son of Protogonia dau. of Deucalion) -> Endymion -> Aetolus -> Pleuron/Calydon -> Agenor -> Porthaon -> Oeneus (+ Althaea -> Meleager & Deianira [wife of Heracles!]; + Periboea -> Tydeus [Seven Against Thebes] -> Diomedes [Iliad hero!]).

nodes.name: Salmoneus → Tyro (+ Poseidon) → Pelias (Iolcus) & Neleus (Pylos) → Nestor (Trojan War Counselor)
nodes.role: Neleid Kings of Pylos & Pelias of Iolcus
nodes.notes: Tyro bore twins Pelias (usurped Iolcus -> Alcestis & Acastus) and Neleus (+ Chloris -> 12 sons, of whom only Nestor survived Heracles's raid, becoming the wise elder king of Pylos at Troy -> Antilochus & Pisistratus!).

nodes.name: Cretheus → Aeson → Jason (Argonauts + Medea of Colchis), Amythaon (Melampus/Adrastus) & Pheres (Admetus)
nodes.role: Cretheid House of Iolcus, Seer Melampus & Leader of the Argonauts
nodes.notes: Aeson -> Jason (led the Argonauts to Colchis to win the Golden Fleece from King Aeetes; married Medea -> Medeus/Medus, eponymous ancestor of the Medes in Greek myth!). Amythaon -> Melampus (seer -> Amphiaraus) & Bias -> Talaus -> King Adrastus of Argos.

nodes.name: Sisyphus (+ Merope) → Glaucus → Bellerophon (Slayer of the Chimera) & Phrixus/Helle (Athamas)
nodes.role: Corinthian & Boeotian Aeolids (Pegasus, Chimera & Golden Fleece)
nodes.notes: Sisyphus (founder of Corinth) -> Glaucus -> Bellerophon (rode winged Pegasus to slay the Chimera in Lycia -> grandfather of Trojan War allies Glaucus & Sarpedon!). Athamas -> Phrixus & Helle (origin of the Golden Fleece & Hellespont!).

nodes.name: Hypermnestra & Lynceus → Abas → Acrisius (→ Danaë → Perseus) & Proetus (Tiryns)
nodes.role: Sole Surviving Danaid Line Bridging Egypt (Belus/Aegyptus) to Perseus
nodes.notes: Hypermnestra spared her husband Lynceus (son of Aegyptus), becoming ancestor of all later Argive & Mycenaean kings: Abas -> twin kings Acrisius (Argos -> Danae + Zeus -> Perseus!) and Proetus (Tiryns -> Megapenthes).

nodes.name: Perseus & Andromeda → Perses, Alcaeus (→ Amphitryon), Sthenelus (→ Eurystheus) & Electryon (→ Alcmene → Heracles)
nodes.role: Complete Perseid Royal House of Mycenae & Tiryns
nodes.notes: Perseus's sons married daughters of Pelops: Sthenelus -> Eurystheus (taskmaster of Heracles's 12 Labors); Alcaeus -> Amphitryon; Electryon -> Alcmene (bore Heracles by Zeus & twin Iphicles -> Iolaus by Amphitryon!).

nodes.name: Return of the Heraclidae: Heracles → Hyllus → Cleodaeus → Aristomachus → Temenus (Argos), Cresphontes (Messene) & Aristodemus (→ Eurysthenes & Procles of Sparta!)
nodes.role: Dorian Conquest of the Peloponnese & Dual Kingship of Sparta
nodes.notes: Three generations after Hyllus, the Heraclidae conquered the Peloponnese with the Dorians: Temenus received Argos (ancestors of the Argead Kings of Macedon -> Alexander the Great!); Cresphontes took Messene; Aristodemus's twins Eurysthenes & Procles founded the Agiad & Eurypontid dual royal dynasties of Sparta (down to Leonidas of Thermopylae!).

nodes.name: Minos & Pasiphaë → Catreus (→ Aerope), Deucalion (→ Idomeneus), Ariadne, Phaedra & Minotaur
nodes.role: Complete Cretan Royal Family (Bridging Minos to Agamemnon & Theseus!)
nodes.notes: Minos's son Catreus fathered Aerope (mother of Agamemnon & Menelaus!) and Clymene (mother of Palamedes); son Deucalion fathered Trojan War commander Idomeneus; daughters Ariadne & Phaedra linked Crete to Theseus of Athens.

nodes.name: Cadmus & Harmonia → Polydorus → Labdacus → Laius (+ Jocasta) → Oedipus → Eteocles, Polynices, Antigone & Ismene (Seven Against Thebes & Epigoni)
nodes.role: Complete Labdacid Dynasty of Thebes (Plus Semele → Dionysus & Illyrius)
nodes.notes: Cadmus's daughters: Semele (mother of Dionysus), Ino, Autonoe (mother of Actaeon), Agave (mother of Pentheus). Son Illyrius (eponym of Illyria!). Polydorus -> Labdacus -> Laius -> Oedipus -> Seven Against Thebes (Polynices, Adrastus, Tydeus, Amphiaraus, Capaneus, Hippomedon, Parthenopaeus) & Epigoni (Alcmaeon, Diomedes, Thersander).

nodes.name: Pelasgus → Lycaon (50 Sons & Callisto) → Arcas → Aleus (→ Auge + Heracles → Telephus) & Atalanta
nodes.role: Autochthonous Pelasgian Kings of Arcadia & Heroine Atalanta
nodes.notes: Lycaon's impiety triggered Deucalion's Flood (only son Nyctimus survived); Callisto + Zeus -> Arcas (eponym of Arcadia & Ursa Major) -> Elatus & Aphidas -> Aleus -> Auge (+ Heracles -> King Telephus of Mysia!) & Lycurgus -> Iasus -> Atalanta (mother of Parthenopaeus).

nodes.name: Atlas & Pleione → 7 Pleiades (Maia → Hermes; Taygete → Lacedaemon → Tyndareus + Leda → Helen, Clytemnestra, Castor & Pollux; Icarius → Penelope)
nodes.role: Complete Atlantid Line of Hermes, Sparta, Helen of Troy & Penelope
nodes.notes: Lacedaemon (+ Sparta) -> Amyclas -> Cynortes -> Perieres/Oebalus -> Tyndareus (+ Leda -> Helen, Clytemnestra, Dioscuri Castor & Pollux) & Icarius (father of Penelope, wife of Odysseus!). Leucippus's daughter Arsinoe/Coronis + Apollo -> Asclepius (god of medicine!).

nodes.name: Asopus → Aegina (+ Zeus) → Aeacus → Telamon (→ Ajax & Teucer) & Peleus (+ Thetis → Achilles → Neoptolemus)
nodes.role: Aeacid Heroes of the Trojan War & Ancestors of Olympias/Alexander!
nodes.notes: Aeacus (Judge of the Dead) fathered Telamon (King of Salamis -> Ajax the Great & Teucer [founder of Salamis in Cyprus!]) and Peleus (+ Nereid Thetis -> Achilles -> Neoptolemus/Pyrrhus, ancestor of the Molossian Kings of Epirus, Queen Olympias [mother of Alexander the Great!], and King Pyrrhus!).

nodes.name: Kings of Athens: Cecrops → Erichthonius → Pandion I (Procne/Philomela) → Erechtheus (Creusa/Orithyia) → Aegeus → Theseus → Demophon
nodes.era: Attic Heroic Era (Apollodorus III.xiv.1-Epit. I; Eusebius)
nodes.role: Complete Mythic Royal Genealogy of Athens (Slayer of the Minotaur)
nodes.notes: Earth-born Cecrops (1st King of Athens) -> Erichthonius -> Pandion I -> Erechtheus (daughter Creusa married Xuthus -> Ion, eponym of Ionians!) -> Pandion II -> Aegeus (+ Aethra of Troezen, dau. of Pittheus son of Pelops!) -> Theseus (slew Minotaur; + Antiope -> Hippolytus; + Phaedra -> Acamas & Demophon).

nodes.name: Tantalus → Niobe & Pelops (+ Hippodamia) → Atreus, Thyestes & Pittheus → Agamemnon, Menelaus, Aegisthus, Iphigenia, Electra & Orestes
nodes.role: Complete House of Atreus from Tantalus to Orestes & Tisamenus
nodes.notes: Tantalus -> Pelops (eponym of Peloponnese!) -> Atreus (+ Aerope of Crete -> Agamemnon & Menelaus), Thyestes (-> Aegisthus), Pittheus (grandfather of Theseus!), plus daughters Astydamia/Nicippe/Lysidice (mothers of Perseids!). Agamemnon + Clytemnestra -> Orestes (+ Hermione -> Tisamenus, slain by Heraclidae!), Electra & Iphigenia.

Helios -> Aeetes of Colchis -> Medea (wife of Jason)

Perseus + Andromeda -> Electryon -> Alcmene & Sthenelus -> Eurystheus
Heracles -> Hyllus -> Cleodaeus -> Aristomachus -> Temenus, Cresphontes & Aristodemus
Minos + Pasiphae -> Catreus (Aerope), Deucalion (Idomeneus), Ariadne, Phaedra
Cadmus + Harmonia -> Polydorus -> Labdacus -> Laius -> Oedipus -> Epigoni
Niobe (dau. of Phoroneus) -> Pelasgus -> Lycaon -> Arcas -> Telephus & Atalanta

Peleus -> Achilles -> Neoptolemus (ancestor of Alexander's mother Olympias!)
